name: sigx-ai-monorepo
description: AI for SignalX — provider-neutral streaming core, Anthropic and OpenAI providers, and the useChat/useCompletion/useObject composables

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sigx/json-ui build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-agent build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-agent-node build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-agent-acp build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-agent-claude-code build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-agent-codex build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-agent-copilot build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-anthropic build && pnpm --filter @sigx/ai-openai build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter chat-example typecheck && pnpm --filter agent-example typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/ai/src packages/ai-agent/src packages/ai-agent-node/src packages/ai-agent-acp/src packages/ai-agent-claude-code/src packages/ai-agent-codex/src packages/ai-agent-copilot/src packages/ai-anthropic/src packages/ai-openai/src packages/json-ui/src examples/chat/src examples/agent/src
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix packages/ai/src packages/ai-agent/src packages/ai-agent-node/src packages/ai-agent-acp/src packages/ai-agent-claude-code/src packages/ai-agent-codex/src packages/ai-agent-copilot/src packages/ai-anthropic/src packages/ai-openai/src packages/json-ui/src examples/chat/src examples/agent/src
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules examples/*/dist examples/*/node_modules node_modules

author: Andreas Ekdahl
